name: Start 4-Hour Admin Session

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - Db  # 👈 This tells GitHub explicitly that the 'main' branch owns this workflow!

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  run-admin-server:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
          pip install uvicorn

      - name: Install Localtunnel via NPM
        # Node and npm are already pre-installed on the runner. Zero keys needed!
        run: sudo npm install -g localtunnel
        
      - name: Start FastAPI Backend in Background
        run: |
          cd backend
          uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 &
        
      - name: Start Localtunnel & Display Public URL
        run: |
          # 1. Give FastAPI 5 seconds to fully boot up
          sleep 5
          
          # 2. Start localtunnel in the BACKGROUND (&) and save logs to a file
          npx lt --port 8000 > localtunnel.log 2>&1 &
          
          # 3. Wait 5 seconds for localtunnel to secure a public URL link
          sleep 5
          
          # 4. Read the text file and print the generated URL out to the console logs
          echo "=========================================================="
          echo "YOUR LIVE ADMIN BACKEND URL IS:"
          cat localtunnel.log | grep -o 'https://[^ ]*' || cat localtunnel.log
          echo "=========================================================="

      - name: Keep Server Active for 4 Hours
        run: |
          echo "Server is now live. System accepting data logs..."
          sleep 14400  # 14400 seconds = 4 hours
          
      - name: Auto-Save SQLite Database to Repository
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@://github.com"
          
          # Stage the runtime database file containing any actions
          git add backend/form_data.db || true
          
          # Commit and push changes back into your GitHub files
          git commit -m "chore: auto-saved session administrative database [skip ci]" || echo "No changes recorded."
          git push
